observationBoundary: Input quantities and preflight/capture records are injected trusted measurement observations. Scorers cannot authenticate an OS observation. Publication is independently acquired custody, never caller authority. Public TEST fixture tree hashes identify local inert design inputs only.
notScored: actual signing/notarization; real container emission; native OS trace capture or startup/RSS measurement
waiver approval and second-qualified-release regression policy remain their already specified separate qualification process; this unit evaluates fixed absolute/measurement-mandatory predicates
G22 complete TCB identities, actual filesystem/project side effects and real launch capture
sourceSectionsAreProposed: The parent sections are separately proposed choices; independent review of this unit does not adopt the parent. Exact section hashes prevent silent drift.
